change_boundary.description: The approved mockups change fixed room sizing, the execution-selector limit, the visible auto-send state, verified per-item active-turn injection, durable terminal and idle-timeout reconciliation, and the Codex status constraint. Todo placement and rendering, durable queue and restart recovery, and delivery acknowledgement are completed Epic 1-9 baseline context.

evidence.detail: The current product still uses percentage room widths, exposes execution lists without the approved eight-entry cap, and keeps the remaining steering gaps in the current implementation.
Epic 1 through Epic 9 are the completed comparison history used for classification.
